title: Unveiling a growth temperature-dependent ultra-sensitive tetragonal scheelite BiVO4 thin film-based gas sensor for ammonia volatilization at room temperature
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39498-39510
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08169B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Santhosh Nallakumar, Logu Thirumalaisamy, Sivaperuman Kalainathan, Vijaya B, Anand Sekar, Muthurakku Usha Rani
A tetragonal scheelite BiVO4 thin film shows high sensor response (S = 900 for 75 ppm) to ammonia at room temperature (RT). Prolonged stability (S = 58.2 for 25 ppm), good repeatability makes it a promising candidate for an ammonia gas sensor at RT.
